meta.title: About us
meta.description: History, vision, partners, board, and facilities of Al Muttaqin Cultural Center, a mosque and Islamic cultural center in Matsudo, Chiba.

hero.title: A mosque and a home for learning in Matsudo, Chiba.
hero.description: Al Muttaqin Cultural Center serves worshippers, new Muslims, families, and neighbors in Japanese, English, and Indonesian. This page explains who we are, where we came from, and how we work.

profile.title: Who we are
profile.body: The center is run by volunteers from the Japanese and Indonesian Muslim communities of Chiba. Daily prayers, the Friday khutbah, weekly study circles, a Quran school for children, a course for new Muslims, and a Japanese language class all take place under one roof, and the doors are open to anyone who wants to learn about Islam.

vision.title: Four pillars of our work
vision.statement: Our vision is a mosque that is calm to pray in, easy to learn in, and welcoming to the neighborhood. We pursue it through four pillars.

0.title: Worship
0.description: Five daily congregational prayers, Jumuah, tarawih, and Eid, with accurate times and a quiet, clean space for everyone.

1.title: Support for new Muslims
1.description: Small-group courses in Japanese, mentoring, and a community that stays close after the shahada.

2.title: Education for the next generation
2.description: Quran school for children, youth circles, and parenting support so faith grows naturally in Japan.

3.title: Halal economy and cultural dialogue
3.description: A halal guide, a dawah dictionary, open mosque days, and partnerships with schools and local government.

history.title: From an idea to a mosque
history.description: A short timeline of how the center came to be. Dates will be updated by the committee as milestones are reached.

partners.title: Built together with our partners
partners.description: The center is operated by the Chiba Islamic Culture Center and supported by Dompet Dhuafa in Indonesia and Japan.

board.title: The people behind the center
board.description: A volunteer board oversees worship, education, finances, and community programs. Names and photos are added as the committee confirms them.

facilities.title: What you will find here
facilities.description: A simple building designed for prayer, classes, and gatherings, with separate spaces for men and women.

governance.title: Every yen is accounted for
governance.body: Donations are held in a dedicated account, and the board publishes a monthly report of all income and expenses. Large purchases are explained, and zakat is tracked separately from infaq and waqf.

items.0: Monthly income and expense reports published on this site
items.1: Two signatures required for every expense above the approved limit
items.2: Annual summary reviewed by the operating organization

volunteer.title: Become a volunteer
volunteer.body: The center runs on volunteers. Whether you can give an hour a month or a day a week, there is a place for you.

items.0: Teaching at the children's Quran school or the Japanese class
items.1: Guiding visitors on Open Mosque Day and translating
items.2: Cooking for iftar, cleaning, and helping at events
